source.rationale: The merge arm on master_products: it is an escalate branch, so the catalogue disclaimer is NOT appended even though the roster is non-empty. It also exercises the company-label fallback — a row with an EMPTY companies[] falls back to its company_name, which is what keeps a two-company roster labelled when only one row carries the list form. NOTE FIELD DELETED 2026-08-24 (captain: the multi-company note was annoying, and the routing-axis widening made its claim false - it is the TURN that spans two companies, not any one subject). The `cs_multi_note` this fixture used to carry in build-cs-member-offer's output is gone from the INPUT too, because the producer no longer writes the key at all; the multi-company signal is now read straight off routing_companies.length, which is the same signal the note was ever evidence of (multi = planItems.length > 1, and routing_companies IS planItems). Everything else this fixture pins - the per-company labels, the omitted-line for a queried company with an empty roster, selection_context - is unchanged, and that is the point: only the note paragraph left the expected text.
